blocks.prompt: 9. Differentiate w.r.t. the variable involved: \(y = \sec(\tan x)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh function ke andar function ki misaal hai: bahar \(\sec\) hai aur us ke andar \(\tan x\).
Diya kya hai? \(y = \sec(\tan x)\). Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Rule kaunsa? Chain rule. Andar wale \(\tan x\) ko \(u\) kahenge taa ke \(y = \sec u\) ban jaye.
Plan: \(\frac{dy}{du}\) aur \(\frac{du}{dx}\) alag nikalenge, multiply karenge, aur \(u\) ko wapas \(\tan x\) se badlenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \sec(\tan x)\).
Maloom karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: chain rule, substitution \(u = \tan x\). Socho jaise ek dabba doosre dabbe ke andar hai: pehle bahar wala kholte hain, phir andar wala.

Substitution karein
\[u = \tan x,\quad y = \sec u\]
Kyun: bahar wala function \(\sec\) hai aur andar wala \(\tan x\). Naam dene se dono alag alag nazar aate hain.

Dono derivatives
\[\dfrac{dy}{du} = \sec u\tan u\]
\[\dfrac{du}{dx} = \sec^2 x\]
Kyun: \((\sec u)' = \sec u\tan u\), jo Question 1(a) mein derive kiya; aur \((\tan x)' = \sec^2 x\), kitab ki Example 1 se.

Chain rule se jorein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \sec u\tan u \cdot \sec^2 x\]
\[= \sec^2 x\,\sec(\tan x)\tan(\tan x)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{du}\cdot\frac{du}{dx}\). Phir \(u\) ki jagah \(\tan x\) wapas bracket ke andar rakha.
Dhyan dein: \(\tan u\) ko wapas likhte waqt \(\tan(\tan x)\) aata hai, \(\tan^2 x\) nahi. \(\tan^2 x\) ka matlab \(\tan x \cdot \tan x\) hai, jabke \(\tan(\tan x)\) ka matlab hai \(\tan x\) ki value ka phir se tan.

Tasdeeq \(x = 0\) par
\[\sec^2 0\,\sec 0\tan 0 = 1 \cdot 1 \cdot 0 = 0\]
Kyun: \(x = 0\) par \(\tan x = 0\), aur \(\sec\) ka graph 0 par apne sab se neeche wale point par hota hai, jahan woh bilkul flat hai. Is liye slope zero hona chahiye, aur formula bhi zero deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein do hidayat (instruction lines) aapas mein takrati hain: 'In 7 - 9, find \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) by making suitable substitutions and applying the Chain Rule' aur 'In 9 - 12, differentiate w.r.t the variable involved'. Dono mein Question 9 shamil hai. Pehli line ghaliban 'In 7 - 8' honi chahiye thi. Jawab par koi asar nahi: humne substitution aur chain rule hi istemal kiya, jo dono hidayat ko poora karta hai.
